hostile_matrix: Exact positive controls: I checked GitHub issue duplicates locally; We searched GitHub issues for duplicates locally; the exact receipt supports once and its absence yields one unsupported finding.

Exact terminal counterexample I checked no GitHub issue duplicates locally and direct variants I did not check, I never checked, I checked without searching and I checked zero/no duplicates locally never become supported.
Passive, attributed and reported forms including The search completed locally, The tool checked, The user said I checked and According to the report duplicates were checked never become supported.
Quoted, inline-code and nested-looking examples are masked before classification and cannot create or lend a claim.
If, when, would, could, should, might, maybe, can you, please, requested, future and intention clauses never become supported regardless of receipt.

Mixed clauses are independent and contradiction-closed: an exact positive followed by but I did not or maybe not is not supported; a quoted/reported positive cannot support a different first-person negative clause.
A reported negative followed by one exact unquoted first-person positive may use the receipt only for that positive clause; no actor or modality state crosses clause boundaries.

Noncanonical result narratives such as I checked locally and found no duplicates remain unsupported unless they exactly satisfy the closed full-clause grammar; no post-verb token can evade classification.
